title: celestia-rs nodes
description: Health of the celestia-rs consensus nodes on this Mac (packaging/macos/monitoring).

panels.title: Node
panels.description: Node process exists and its Prometheus endpoint answers.

panels.title: Role
panels.description: Validating: x/slashing has signing info for this node's consensus key. JAILED: jailed or tombstoned.

panels.title: App hash vs Go
panels.description: check-apphash.sh every 5 min against the reference Go RPC in nodes.conf. MISMATCH is a parity bug: stop the validator (operator guide §11.7).

panels.title: Last block age
panels.description: Now minus latest_block_time from /status. node-metrics.sh samples /status every 30 s, so up to ~45 s is normal.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alert rules (rules.yml). Details: Alerting > Alert rules.

panels.title: Blocks behind signing
panels.description: Latest block height minus the last height our validator signed. 0 = signing every block.

panels.title: Signed blocks (range)
panels.description: Share of blocks our validator signed over the dashboard's time range (node-local view).

targets.expr: 1 - (sum by (network) (increase(cometbft_consensus_validator_missed_blocks{network=~"$network"}[$__range])) or max by (network) (cometbft_consensus_validator_last_signed_height{network=~"$network"}) * 0) / sum by (network) (increase(cometbft_consensus_latest_block_height{network=~"$network"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Missed in slashing window
panels.description: x/slashing missed_blocks_counter over the last signed_blocks_window blocks (chain view).

panels.title: Jail budget used
panels.description: missed / (window x (1 - min_signed_per_window)). The validator is jailed at 100%.

panels.title: Missed blocks (per minute)
panels.description: Blocks whose commit lacks our signature, as seen by this node.

panels.title: Slashing window: missed blocks
panels.description: x/slashing missed_blocks_counter over the signed_blocks_window. 'Jail budget used' shows how close it is to jailing.

panels.title: Missing validators (voting power %)
panels.description: Share of voting power absent from the last commit.

panels.title: Consensus rounds
panels.description: Round of the current height. Above 0 means a proposal failed.
